label: Printful catalog items
description: One row per Printful catalog variant, with the costs needed to price and submit it. Populated by the catalog sync.

catalog_variant_id.description: Printful catalog variant id, and this row's identity. Marked unique, which in Swell is a read-then-write validation rather than a database index — it will not stop two concurrent writes creating the same variant twice.

catalog_product_id.description: Printful catalog product this variant belongs to

variant_id.description: Swell product variant this catalog variant is sold as

base_cost_by_technique.description: Printful base price keyed by technique id. The base price already includes one placement — subtract it before adding placement prices or the first placement is counted twice

placement_prices.description: Additional price keyed by placement id, for placements beyond the one included in the base cost

currency.description: Currency the costs above are quoted in

stale.description: Set by the catalog_price_changed and catalog_stock_updated webhooks. The next sync run refetches these rows first

date_synced.description: When this row last matched Printful
